name: dravr
description: Your training, recovery and nutrition data, analysed by Dravr.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your Dravr account. Dravr brings the activities, sleep, recovery and nutrition your connected fitness services record together with training load, recovery and pattern analysis, as MCP tools Claude can call.

On first use a browser window opens to sign in to Dravr; the session is kept in your operating system's keychain. Point the extension at another Dravr server with the Server URL setting.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: The Dravr MCP server to connect to. Leave the default unless your organisation runs its own.
